title: LINCOLN NATIONAL CORP 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Lincoln National Corporation filed a Form 8-K on April 16, 2026, announcing the planned retirement of Brian Kroll, Executive Vice President and Head of Retail Life and Annuity Solutions, effective June 1, 2026. The company stated this is part of a planned succession for the Retail Life and Annuities businesses. This is a standard corporate governance filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Brian Kroll, EVP and Head of Retail Life and Annuity Solutions, will retire effective June 1, 2026
The departure is described as part of a planned succession for the Retail Life and Annuities businesses
Kroll was disclosed as a named executive officer in the company's 2026 proxy statement filed April 16, 2026
The filing was signed by Nancy A. Smith, Senior Vice President and Secretary
